name: Harriet Martineau
shortBio: British social theorist widely recognized as the first female sociologist; pioneered empirical sociological field methodology, translated Auguste Comte's Cours de Philosophie Positive, and analyzed institutional hypocrisy across race, class, and gender.
centralQuestion: How can empirical observation of everyday manners, institutions, and economic arrangements uncover whether a society lives up to its professed moral principles?

keyWorks.title: Society in America
keyWorks.description: Foundational comparative empirical study examining slavery, women's subordination, and democratic institutions in the early United States.

keyWorks.title: How to Observe Morals and Manners
keyWorks.description: The first systematic treatise on sociological research methodology, establishing principles of bias awareness, representative sampling, and institutional analysis.
